tiktok_title: Busui boleh makan pedas dan minum es? Ini yang beneran perlu dibatasi
caption:
"Jangan makan pedas, nanti bayinya mencret." "Jangan minum es, nanti bayinya pilek." Kata CDC, umumnya ibu menyusui nggak perlu menghindari makanan tertentu. Bayi pilek itu karena virus, bukan karena es yang kamu minum.

Yang beneran ada batasnya: kafein sekitar 300 mg sehari (2-3 gelas kopi), ikan rendah merkuri 2-3 porsi seminggu, dan alkohol paling aman nggak sama sekali.

Bayi kelihatan rewel tiap kamu makan sesuatu? Catat, terus tanya dokter atau konselor laktasi. Bukan salah Nenek kok, ilmunya aja yang udah update.

Sumber: CDC, NHS, UNICEF Indonesia

sources: CDC, Maternal Diet (breastfeeding special circumstances): generally, women do not need to limit or avoid specific foods while breastfeeding. Caffeine about 300 mg or less per day (2 to 3 cups of coffee) usually does not harm the infant. Fish: 2 to 3 servings (8 to 12 oz) a week from Best Choices, 1 serving from Good Choices, avoid the high-mercury list. https://www.cdc.gov/breastfeeding-special-circumstances/hcp/diet-micronutrients/maternal-diet.html

NHS Start for Life, Food and drinks to avoid when breastfeeding: no more than 300 mg caffeine a day. Limit swordfish, marlin, shark to 1 portion a week, no more than 2 portions of oily fish a week. No evidence to avoid peanuts unless allergic. 'It's safer not to drink any alcohol'. https://www.nhs.uk/start-for-life/baby/feeding-your-baby/breastfeeding/healthy-diet-when-breastfeeding/food-and-drinks-to-avoid-when-breastfeeding/

UNICEF Indonesia, Terjawab: 14 Mitos tentang Menyusui: ibu menyusui butuh menu bergizi seimbang, nggak perlu makanan hambar. Kalau bayi bereaksi pada makanan tertentu, konsultasi ke dokter. https://www.unicef.org/indonesia/id/gizi/artikel/terjawab-14-mitos-tentang-menyusui
